screens.name: Home — unavailable omen and transition
screens.evidence: home.png and home-transition.png retain the orb-led composition, with supplied browser evidence supporting text contrast and navigation clearance.
findings: Increase the example question’s visual prominence so it reads as useful inspiration above the dominant orb.

screens.name: Home — successful omen fixture
screens.evidence: home-omen-fixture.png shows a distinct free-omen section above navigation; its synthetic content establishes layout only.
findings: Preserve the omen’s current separation from the main ask action when testing longer real content.

screens.name: Home — 360px enlarged navigation
screens.evidence: navigation-360-200pct.png shows five enlarged single-line labels, and supplied browser checks report preserved scroll clearance.
findings: Verify that enlarged navigation and lower Home content remain reachable with native text scaling and physical safe areas.

screens.name: Approach — settled and transition
screens.evidence: approach.png and approach-transition.png preserve the large orb and opening message, with automatic progression and reduced-motion bypass reported.
findings: Verify that assistive technology reaches the destination without announcing this brief intermediate screen unnecessarily.

screens.name: Ask — normal and transition
screens.evidence: ask.png and ask-transition.png show stable field, disclosure and submission placement, supported by the reported browser reading flow.
findings: Replace the technical phrase 'your prediction engine' with a clearer explanation of where submitted questions go.

screens.name: Ask — enlarged
screens.evidence: ask-large.png prioritizes enlarged question text and retains both voice and submit actions within the capture.
findings: Check the same layout with a physical keyboard open and native text enlargement.

screens.name: Listening — voice unavailable and transition
screens.evidence: listening.png and listening-transition.png elevate typing and show a microphone failure notice, while microphone hardware remains unverified.
findings: Move the failure explanation closer to the typing fallback so the reason for the changed action is immediately apparent.

screens.name: Question 1 — choices and transition
screens.evidence: card-1.png and its transition show a clear question, four separated answers and progress, with keyboard advancement reported.
findings: Verify that screen readers announce the new question and progress after immediate answer advancement.

screens.name: Question 2 — choices and transition
screens.evidence: card-2.png and its transition retain the same answer structure and show progress at 2 of 3.
findings: Preserve the stable question and answer positions when real follow-up text becomes longer.

screens.name: Question 3 — choices and transition
screens.evidence: card-3.png and its transition show the final question with consistent spacing and explicit 3 of 3 progress.
findings: Verify that the final answer clearly announces the move into prediction generation.

screens.name: Question — keyboard heading focus
screens.evidence: answer-keyboard-focus.png shows visible heading focus, and supplied checks report Tab reaching the first answer and Back restoring the prior answer.
findings: Give the heading focus outline slightly more breathing room around the text.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty and transition
screens.evidence: card-other.png and its transition show question context, Change, multiline entry and a dimmed Continue button.
findings: Add a short empty-input cue explaining what enables Continue.

screens.name: Custom answer — enlarged empty
screens.evidence: card-other-large.png retains the complete enlarged question, labeled input, Change action and disabled submission.
findings: Keep the enabling instruction visible when the empty field and button are enlarged.

screens.name: Custom answer — enlarged filled
screens.evidence: custom-filled-200pct.png shows question context, a retained multiline answer and a fully visible Reveal my prediction button.
findings: Repeat this check with longer answers to verify caret visibility and field scrolling.

screens.name: Custom answer — synthetic keyboard constraint
screens.evidence: custom-synthetic-keyboard.png keeps the answer and submit button visible but does not show the full question in the pictured constrained viewport.
findings: Keep a compact question label visible while editing in the reduced viewport.

screens.name: Planning — loading and transition
screens.evidence: planning.png and its transition explain the current step, possible duration, credit protection and cancellation.
findings: Verify that elapsed waits and cancellation results are announced without repeatedly announcing ambient changes.

screens.name: Research — loading and transition
screens.evidence: research.png and its transition distinguish prediction research from planning while retaining time and credit reassurance.
findings: Make the change from planning to research explicit in assistive-technology status announcements.

screens.name: Planning error — settled and transition
screens.evidence: error-plan.png and its transition pair a failure heading with no-charge reassurance, retry and question editing.
findings: Preserve the contextual retry and edit actions when replacing fixture text with real error details.

screens.name: Prediction error — settled and transition
screens.evidence: error-predict.png and its transition add Review answers alongside retry and question editing.
findings: Verify that recovering through Review answers restores the exact previously entered content.

screens.name: Sensitive planning redirect — settled and transition
screens.evidence: sensitive-plan.png and its transition provide support, alternate-question recovery and explicit no-credit/no-memory reassurance.
findings: Give Find support near you greater emphasis than starting another entertainment reading.

screens.name: Sensitive prediction redirect — settled and transition
screens.evidence: sensitive-predict.png and its transition preserve the same support and recovery structure after prediction processing.
findings: Prioritize the support route visually while retaining a clear way to edit the question.

screens.name: Reveal — collapsed and transition
screens.evidence: reveal.png and its transition show forecast, uncertainty, explanation disclosure, check-back date and sharing, with a real browser reading flow reported separately.
findings: Reduce competition among the four secondary actions beneath Share this glimpse.

screens.name: Reveal — expanded explanation and transition
screens.evidence: reveal-why.png and its transition reveal a long text block beneath the unchanged large forecast, pushing further content below the viewport.
findings: Present the explanation as shorter labeled sections so long content is easier to scan.

screens.name: Check-in — unanswered and transition
screens.evidence: check-in.png and its transition place three outcome choices below the forecast while the filled Share button remains the strongest control.
findings: Make the outcome question the primary emphasis when the user enters a check-in.

screens.name: Check-in — Yes saved
screens.evidence: outcome-yes-saved.png shows inline saved status, a checked Yes and confirmation notice, with persistence reported using actual storage.
findings: Use one outcome term consistently across the Yes control, saved status and History.

screens.name: Check-in — Not quite saved
screens.evidence: outcome-no-saved.png repeats Not quite in the selected control and saved status, supported by reported reload persistence.
findings: Verify that the confirmation notice does not obscure actions or steal focus during outcome changes.

screens.name: Check-in — Not yet saved
screens.evidence: outcome-pending-saved.png distinguishes a checked pending outcome from failure and reports that the status is saved.
findings: Verify that users can later replace Not yet without ambiguity or duplicate history entries.

screens.name: History — empty and transition
screens.evidence: history.png and its transition show device-local storage scope, an empty-state explanation and an Ask the Ball action.
findings: Give the empty-state Ask action slightly stronger emphasis within the otherwise sparse screen.

screens.name: History — populated and transition
screens.evidence: history-filled.png and its transition distinguish original question, forecast, creation date and check-back date.
findings: Format check-back dates in readable month names rather than ISO notation.

screens.name: History — stress list
screens.evidence: history-stress.png shows repeated rows continuing below the viewport, with supplied layout evidence reporting footer clearance.
findings: Verify the final row and its actions remain fully reachable beneath the raised Ask navigation item.

screens.name: History — persisted outcome
screens.evidence: history-outcome-persisted.png visibly replaces the first row’s pending date with a checked Came true status.
findings: Keep outcome terminology identical between saved readings and History.

screens.name: Sky — offline samples and transition
screens.evidence: sky.png and its transition disclose offline samples, mark Love with a check and keep Ask this too visible.
findings: Verify generous hit areas and a logical screen-reader order for the scattered star choices.

screens.name: Circles — offline
screens.evidence: circles-offline.png shows an offline notice, retry, disabled creation and an unavailable sharing preference.
findings: Collapse the repeated circle introduction and place each unavailable control’s reason directly beside it.

screens.name: Plans — normal and transition
screens.evidence: paywall.png and its transition show test-mode disclosure, checkmarked yearly selection, total prices and simulated purchase actions.
findings: Repeat the selected billing total in the main continuation label to make the commitment easier to confirm.

screens.name: Plans — enlarged
screens.evidence: paywall-large.png stacks enlarged billing details clearly, while the continuation button extends beyond the pictured bottom edge.
findings: Verify that the entire continuation control and subsequent plan alternatives are reachable with native enlarged text.

screens.name: Share — settled and transition
screens.evidence: share.png and its transition show a portrait preview and three labeled actions, while the supplied runtime proves PNG export but not OS delivery.
findings: Align the Story video label with the demonstrated story-card output, or substantiate the promised four-second video.

screens.name: Story — settled and transition
screens.evidence: story.png and its transition show a large portrait card and Export story card, with Back to sharing near the viewport boundary.
findings: State the export format consistently with the preceding sharing action.

screens.name: You — empty memory and transition
screens.evidence: you.png and its transition separate plan, memory and preferences, with reported keyboard activation and preference persistence.
findings: Consolidate the duplicated See plans and View plans and credits destinations.

screens.name: You — preference controls and keyboard focus
screens.evidence: settings-controls.png and settings-focus.png show labeled switches and a prominent row focus outline, with 342×52px targets reported.
findings: Confirm that assistive technology announces each switch’s name, role and current state.

screens.name: You — enlarged preferences
screens.evidence: settings-controls-large.png shows enlarged labels and enabled large text, with lower settings continuing beneath the viewport.
findings: Verify the bottom privacy action can be fully scrolled above navigation on a physical device.

screens.name: You — populated real memory
screens.evidence: you-memory-real.png presents three labeled facts with Edit and Forget, and supplied runtime reports real fact editing, forgetting and Undo.
findings: Include each fact’s name in the accessible labels of repeated Edit and Forget controls.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: The illustrated orb remains visually consistent across sizes, with browser animation performance and stopped reduced-motion draws reported.
findings: Verify a clear accessible name when interactive and exclusion from reading order when decorative.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: Five labeled destinations use an underline and color for active state, and supplied checks report enlarged labels fitting at all tested widths.
findings: Validate physical safe-area clearance and screen-reader selected-tab announcements.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: Headers consistently pair a left title or wordmark with the remaining daily reading count, including enlarged captures.
findings: Use 'reading' in the balance’s accessible label so '1 left today' retains context independently.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream filled buttons carry clear action labels, with visible disabled variants and reported browser submission and recovery flows.
findings: Verify pressed, busy and focus states consistently across every primary action.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Gold text actions recur across disclosure, recovery, sharing and editing, but screenshots do not establish every hit area or pressed state.
findings: Standardize generous targets and reduce clusters of equally weighted secondary actions.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Spacious divided answer rows are supported by reported Space/Enter advancement, heading focus transfer and restored answers.
findings: Verify that immediate advancement remains understandable with VoiceOver and TalkBack.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: The normal question input has a persistent label, serif content, an outer gold border and a second lower rule.
findings: Remove the redundant inner baseline to simplify the field’s visual treatment.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: Enlarged fields retain multiline answers and submission in supplied browser tests, while the constrained screenshot loses visible question context.
findings: Retain a compact question label during keyboard-constrained editing and verify native caret scrolling.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Switches show thumb position and color, with supplied evidence for full-row targets, keyboard activation, focus and persistence.
findings: Confirm role and state announcements using physical assistive technology.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Successful and unavailable omen captures distinguish free content from the main ask flow and provide an unavailable-state next step.
findings: Keep the omen readable above navigation when real content is longer or native text size increases.

components.name: Sky stars and selected question
components.evidence: A checkmark identifies the selected star and its question appears above the visible primary action.
findings: Verify star hit areas and selection announcements rather than relying on the small visible symbols.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: The borderless circle section discloses offline status and privacy scope while disabling unavailable creation.
findings: Shorten the repeated introduction and explain disabled states at their controls.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Rows distinguish question, forecast, date and persisted outcome using alignment, typography and quiet dividers.
findings: Use localized check-back dates and an accessible row label that includes outcome status.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Yearly selection uses a checkmark and divider, with monthly equivalents and billed totals preserved in enlarged stacking.
findings: Verify radio-style selection semantics and repeat the selected total at confirmation.

components.name: Share preview
components.evidence: The portrait preview carries forecast and uncertainty text, and supplied runtime reports actual 1080×1920 PNG export and injected export-error recovery.
findings: Provide readable equivalent text outside the small preview and label the exported format explicitly.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: Notices communicate voice failure and saved outcomes, while error screens offer contextual retry, editing and credit reassurance.
findings: Keep notices near their triggering controls and verify announcement timing without focus theft.

components.name: Typography system
components.evidence: Serif display text and sans-serif utility text have consistent roles, supported by supplied enlarged-layout and sampled contrast checks.
findings: Improve scanning of long explanations and avoid tiny informational text inside previews.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: Dark mist and warm lower illumination support the borderless direction, with supplied sampled contrast and reduced-motion evidence.
findings: Verify text contrast through unsampled animation phases and physical display conditions.

limitations: All grades are provisional: screenshots were evaluated directly, while runtime claims were supplied rather than independently reproduced.
Corresponding transition captures preserve composition and legibility, but still images cannot establish complete temporal continuity or absence of intermediate layout shifts.

Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, keyboard safe areas, VoiceOver/TalkBack, microphone hardware, native haptics, real payments, configured social services and OS share delivery remain unverified.
Synthetic wording is not treated as a production-copy defect and supplies no evidence of predictive accuracy or model quality.
No demonstrated hard-gate failure is established by these materials; cropped scrolling content is not proof that its controls are unreachable.
The authorized threshold is not met: every item has at least one dimension below 9, and the missing physical and assistive-technology evidence prevents 9/10 certification.
A and F are the means of applicable aesthetic and functional dimensions respectively; overall is 0.4A + 0.6F rounded to one decimal, with null excluded only where genuinely inapplicable.
topFixes: Resolve the Story video versus Export story card mismatch and clearly identify the actual export format.
Prioritize support in sensitive redirects and outcome selection in check-in views.
Keep question context visible during keyboard-constrained custom entry.
Simplify long explanations, clustered secondary actions and repeated Circles copy.
Complete physical-device and assistive-technology checks before seeking 9/10 certification.
